sentences.text: M/S. Fehmi Care Nursing Home, vs The State Of Telangana, on

Author: N.Tukaramji
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No. 5200 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No.631 of 2020 of Jubilee Hills Police Station, Hyderabad, against the petitioners.
2. The petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime No.631 of 2020 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

3. Heard Mr.Mohammed Nabeel Ali, learned counsel, representing Mr.Mohd.Muzaferullah Khan,
learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, representing the respondent No.1-State.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that though the petitioners are determined to see the process through and the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment upto seven years, the Police concerned have not issued any notice under Section 41-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short Cr.P.C.), as such, the petitioners are apprehending coercive measures against them.
He further 2 NTR,J submits that the petitioners are ready to cooperate with the investigation, hence prayed for necessary directions for issuance of notice as per law.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the Police concerned are ready to issue notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C.
6.
I have perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment upto seven years and as the petitioners are ready to engage themselves in the process, without going into merits of the matter, the petitioners are directed to appear before the Station House Officer, Jubilee Hills Police Station, on 17.04.2025, whereupon, the Investigating Officer shall issue notice to the petitioners under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. in Crime No.631 of 2020 and take up further proceedings as per the guidelines of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1.
